candidates.name: Minab-Sirik Gas Pipeline
candidates.sponsor: Iranian Gas Engineering and Development Company (IGEDC) / National Iranian Gas Company

evidence.note: IGEDC acting head Behnam Mirzaei: 'completion of the 121-kilometer, 42-inch Minab–Sirik pipeline, which provides the infrastructure for delivering gas to the Kuh-e Mobarak region and facilitating exports to neighboring countries.' Completed Iranian year 1403 (ended Mar 20 2025).

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row for Minab/Sirik/Kuh-e Mobarak endpoints. Distinct 121km/42in transmission line; likely the domestic feed toward the Iran-Oman export scheme (P2225 Iran-Oman) but a separate physical pipe with different endpoints, so not that row.

candidates.name: Ardebil-Garmi Gas Pipeline
candidates.sponsor: Iranian Gas Engineering and Development Company (IGEDC) / National Iranian Gas Company

evidence.note: IGEDC: 'inauguration of the 77-kilometer, 24-inch Ardebil–Garmi pipeline last year, calling it one of the province's most strategic projects.' Completed Iranian year 1403.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row for Ardebil-Garmi. Separate from Rasht-Chelavend (P5984) and from the Chelvand-Ardebil leg; 77km/24in transmission line in northern Ardebil Province.

candidates.name: Dashtak-Nehbandan Gas Pipeline

evidence.note: IGEDC: 'Dorahi Dashtak–Nehbandan gas pipeline ... contributes to completing the eastern gas supply ring and increases supply security in eastern and northeastern Iran.'
Oil Minister Oji inaugurated 'a gas transmission line from Dashtak to Nehbandan' which 'links 160 industrial units including two cement factories to the cross-country gas network.'

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row for Dashtak or Nehbandan. Part of Iran's eastern gas ring; explicitly described as a transmission line tied into the cross-country grid.

candidates.name: Iranshahr-Chabahar Gas Pipeline

evidence.note: Oji inaugurated 'a gas transmission line from Iranshahr to Chabahar' to 'supply the Chabahar power plant's gas needs'; ~$500M invested across the province projects.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row Iranshahr-Chabahar. Roster's only SE line is Zahedan-Zabol (P6028); this is a distinct southern extension of the grid toward Chabahar. Possibly the '154 km southern Sistan-Baluchestan' line cited in later 2025 IGEDC targets.

candidates.name: Chelvand-Ardebil Gas Pipeline

evidence.note: Oil Ministry 2026 target list includes 'more than 50 kilometers of the Chelvand–Ardebil pipeline' among lines to be commissioned by late Mar 2026 (increases transmission capacity).

candidates.why_maybe_new: Distinct from Rasht-Chelavend (P5984, operating): this is the onward Chelvand->Ardebil leg, under construction. No matching roster row.

candidates.name: Laft-Gourzin-Bandar Abbas Gas Pipeline

evidence.note: IGEDC: '37 kilometers of the Laft–Gourzin–Bandar Abbas pipeline were also commissioned, with further expansion planned this year ... expected to supply gas to industries in the Persian Gulf industrial park, Qeshm Island, local power plants, and surrounding industries.'

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row for Laft/Gourzin/Qeshm. Borderline: supplies Qeshm Island power plants and an industrial park (could read as regional distribution), but is a named transmission line partly commissioned/partly under construction. Consolidator to decide transmission vs. gathering/distribution scope.
